title: Bauval, Hancock and Schoch on Sphinx weathering and the Orion 10,500 BC alignment

tellings.quote: like Robert Bauval and Graham Hancock and Robert Schoch who since the 90s have been saying very interesting things about, you know, possibly limestone damage on the Sphinx

plain: Since the 1990s, the writers Robert Bauval and Graham Hancock and the geologist Robert Schoch have argued that the limestone of the Great Sphinx in Egypt shows damage that hints it is far older than usually thought, linked to an alignment with the stars of Orion around 10,500 BC. Michels sums up their work in a sentence, saying they have been "saying very interesting things" about the Sphinx. If they were right, a lost civilization would have built it long before recorded history.
